models.name: Hodos et al.
models.note: Figure 1 为数据特征分析；另附 Figure 2 方法流程图。
models.features: Bulk expression: nearest-neighbor prediction and tensor completion for unmeasured drug–cell-type profiles.

models.name: scGen
models.features: VAE latent-space vector arithmetic transfers perturbation effects to held-out cell populations.

models.name: CellBox
models.features: Interpretable dynamical network model of signaling and viability responses, used to design cancer drug combinations.

models.name: chemCPA
models.features: Chemical-structure embeddings extend a compositional autoencoder to predict responses to unseen drugs.

models.name: MultiCPA
models.features: Compositional latent modeling of multimodal perturbation responses, including unseen combinations of measured interventions.

models.name: scPreGAN
models.note: 截至本次收集，出版商/论文网站限制下载；未获得可核验的公开图像文件。
models.features: Combines an autoencoder with adversarial generation to predict perturbed single-cell expression distributions.

models.name: CellOT
models.features: Learns neural optimal-transport maps between unpaired control and treated cell distributions; fits a map per perturbation.

models.name: CPA
models.features: Disentangles basal state, perturbations, and covariates; composes latent effects to predict doses and perturbation combinations.

models.name: GEARS
models.features: GO-derived perturbation graphs and coexpression graphs support prediction of unseen genetic perturbations and combinations.

models.name: ontoVAE
models.features: Ontology-structured VAE decoder yields interpretable pathway activities and supports in silico genetic/drug perturbations.

models.name: SAMS-VAE
models.features: Sparse additive perturbation embeddings compose with basal cell states in a VAE for response modeling.

models.name: scDiff
models.features: Conditional diffusion framework for multiple single-cell tasks, including perturbation-response prediction.

models.name: scVIDR
models.features: VAE with cell-type-specific latent response vectors and dose interpolation for chemical perturbations.

models.name: biolord
models.features: Disentangles known attributes from residual cell variation and generates counterfactuals by changing attribute embeddings.

models.name: CODEX
models.features: Counterfactual deep learning predicts cancer-cell-line responses to unseen intervention combinations and can incorporate GO priors.

models.name: cycleCDR
models.features: Uses cycle-consistency constraints for bidirectional control–perturbed state mapping; evaluated on chemical and genetic responses.

models.name: PRnet
models.features: Conditions on compound structure and baseline expression to generate chemical responses at bulk and single-cell resolution.

models.name: scDisInFact
models.features: Disentangled VAE separates shared biology, condition-specific factors, and batch effects for integration and condition-response prediction.

models.name: scLAMBDA
models.features: VAE with language-model-derived gene embeddings separates basal and perturbation-specific representations for single/multi-gene prediction.

models.name: STAMP
models.features: Decomposes genetic-response prediction into differential-expression detection, change direction, and change magnitude.

models.name: TranSiGen
models.features: Self-supervised generative representations combine baseline expression and molecular structure to reconstruct chemical-induced transcriptional profiles.

models.name: CausalGRN
models.features: Infers a network skeleton, orients edges using CRISPR effects, and predicts downstream responses through the directed regulatory network.

models.name: CellFlow
models.note: 使用 ETH 机构仓储保存的作者预印本版本。
models.features: Conditional flow matching generates cell-phenotype distributions for chemical, genetic, and signaling perturbations.

models.name: Cradle-VAE
models.note: 使用作者 arXiv 预印本版本。
models.features: Counterfactual artifact disentanglement separates technical effects from biological perturbation signals in a causal generative VAE.

models.name: GPerturb
models.features: Sparse Gaussian-process regression models gene-level perturbation effects and provides uncertainty estimates, including for dose responses.

models.name: IMPA
models.features: Conditional adversarial autoencoder transfers perturbation style to control-cell images to generate morphological responses.

models.name: PerturbNet
models.features: Conditional normalizing flows link perturbation representations to cell-state distributions for unseen chemicals, gene interventions, and coding variants.

models.name: PRESAGE
models.features: Attention-based integration of diverse gene embeddings predicts expression responses to unmeasured genetic perturbations.

models.name: Scouter
models.features: Uses LLM-derived gene embeddings and a compressor–generator network to predict unseen genetic perturbation responses.

models.name: Squidiff
models.features: Diffusion-based generation models cell development and transcriptomic responses to perturbations.

models.name: Conditional Monge Gap
models.features: Conditional optimal transport models drug-, dose-, and combination-dependent single-cell response distributions.

models.name: CSTATE
models.note: 截至本次收集，出版商/论文网站限制下载；未获得可核验的公开图像文件。
models.features: Structural causal modeling over latent gene modules estimates intervention effects conditional on cellular context.

models.name: LCD
models.features: Latent causal diffusion models gene-regulatory dynamics and unseen perturbation combinations; CLIPR interprets direct causal effects.

models.name: MultiPert
models.features: Adversarial alignment and dual attention model perturbation responses across single-cell omics modalities.

models.name: PertAdapt
models.features: Adds a perturbation-conditioned adapter and adaptive loss to foundation models for genetic-response prediction.

models.name: PerturbDiff
models.note: Figure 1 为建模概念示意；另附 Figure 2 模型框架图。
models.features: Functional diffusion operates on population distributions to model hidden-context variation in perturbation responses.

models.name: PerturbLDM
models.note: Figure 1 原图来自作者官方代码仓库。
models.features: Conditional latent diffusion generates single-cell responses in specified drug and cellular contexts.

models.name: PopPert
models.note: Figure 1 为建模范式对比；另附 Figure 2 模型概览。
models.features: Models population-level joint expression distributions with a low-rank Gaussian copula, including cross-gene dependencies.

models.name: PrePR-CT
models.features: Cell-type-specific graphs and inductive biological priors support interpretable drug-response prediction in limited-data settings.

models.name: scBalFlow
models.note: Figure 1 展示数据不平衡；另附 Figure 2 模型结构图。
models.features: Staged flow matching separates response-intensity prediction from expression generation to address imbalanced drug responses.

models.name: scDFM
models.features: Conditional flow matching with population-distribution alignment predicts genetic and chemical responses from unpaired cell populations.

models.name: scDRP
models.features: Disentangles perturbation-dependent response from cell identity to estimate heterogeneous individual treatment effects.

models.name: scLDM
models.features: VAE compression and conditional latent diffusion generate responses conditioned on baseline cell state, cell type, and perturbation.

models.name: scPert
models.features: Transformer fuses LLM-derived gene embeddings with structured biological knowledge for single and combinatorial genetic-response prediction.

models.name: Stack
models.features: Cell-set foundation model uses prompt cells for in-context, counterfactual expression generation across cellular conditions.

models.name: STATE
models.features: Set-based transition model predicts context-dependent perturbation responses; observationally pretrained embeddings provide complementary cell-state information.

models.name: TxPert
models.note: Figure 1 为数据与基准分析；另附 Figure 2 模型框架图。
models.features: Latent transfer integrates multiple gene-interaction knowledge graphs to predict genetic perturbation effects and cross-context responses.

models.name: UniPert-G2CP
models.features: Unifies genetic and chemical molecular representations, then transfers genetic-screen information to chemical phenotype prediction.

models.name: X-Cell
models.features: Diffusion language model uses multimodal biological priors to predict genetic perturbation responses across cellular contexts.

models.name: XPert
models.features: Biologically informed dual-branch transformer models baseline expression, drug-induced changes, and dose/time dependence.

models.name: CellDrift
models.features: Generalized linear models and functional data analysis identify temporal perturbation-response patterns across cell types.

models.name: CONCERT
models.note: 另附 Figure 2，详细展示模型结构。
models.features: Disentangles perturbation/state attributes and learns spatial Gaussian-process kernels for niche-aware counterfactual response prediction.

models.name: UNAGI
models.features: Learns disease-associated cellular dynamics and performs in silico gene/pathway/drug interventions for drug discovery and repurposing.

models.name: AlphaCell
models.features: World-model framework for simulating perturbation-induced cellular dynamics; described in a preprint.

models.name: Celcomen
models.features: Causal graph modeling separates intra- and inter-cellular regulation to generate counterfactual spatial transcriptomics.

models.name: RegVelo
models.features: Couples splicing kinetics with gene-regulatory interactions; supports in silico regulatory perturbation and cell-fate analysis.

models.name: BioDiscoveryAgent
models.features: LLM agent designs genetic perturbation experiments using biological knowledge and observed outcomes; experimental design rather than expression generation.

models.name: PDGrapher
models.features: Inverse design: causally inspired graph networks propose therapeutic target combinations to move a diseased state toward a treated state.

models.name: SequenTx
models.features: Combines a tumour cell-state model with reinforcement learning to design sequential drug treatments.

models.name: DTD
models.note: 截至本次收集，出版商/论文网站限制下载；未获得可核验的公开图像文件。
models.features: Drug–target–disease association prediction by relational tensor factorization; not a single-cell response generator.

models.name: scINSIGHT
models.features: Matrix factorization separates shared and condition-specific gene programs; an integration/interpretation method, not a response predictor.

models.name: CINEMA-OT
models.features: Separates treatment-associated signals from confounders and uses optimal transport to estimate single-cell treatment effects.

models.name: contrastiveVI
models.features: Separates target-specific variation from variation shared with background/control cells; a contrastive analysis model.

models.name: DREEP
models.features: Uses pharmacogenomic sensitivity signatures and enrichment to estimate drug vulnerability from tumour-cell expression; not transcriptome generation.

models.name: MOASL
models.features: Contrastive similarity learning predicts drug mechanisms of action from transcriptomic signatures.

models.name: sVAE
models.features: Models perturbations as sparse interventions on latent mechanisms to learn interpretable cellular representations.

models.name: Cell Painting CNN
models.features: Weakly supervised CNN learns morphological profiles from Cell Painting images; represents observed phenotypes rather than generating responses.

models.name: DRSPRING
models.features: GCN integrates chemical, interaction, and expression information to predict drug-pair synergy; endpoint is synergy, not cell-state generation.

models.name: PertKGE
models.features: Knowledge-graph embedding of perturbation transcriptomics infers compound–protein interactions for target identification and virtual screening.

models.name: SC-VAE
models.features: Guide-supervised contrastive VAE separates perturbation effects from baseline heterogeneity for perturbation interpretation.

models.name: scRank
models.features: Perturbs cell-type-specific regulatory networks in silico to rank drug-responsive populations from untreated scRNA-seq.

models.name: TAT
models.note: Figure 1 为任务概览；另附 Figure 2 模型结构图。使用作者预印本版本。
models.features: Transformer maps dose-dependent transcriptional profiles to compound activity in other assays; not a transcriptome-response generator.

models.name: CellCap
models.features: Sparse response programs and attention model how basal cell state shapes heterogeneous perturbation responses.

models.name: Pertpy
models.features: Modular perturbation-analysis toolkit covering datasets, annotations, distances, and statistical analyses; not one predictive model.

models.name: PS
models.features: Estimates continuous per-cell perturbation strength from downstream expression changes to resolve heterogeneous responses.

models.name: scAgents
models.note: 截至本次收集，出版商/论文网站限制下载；未获得可核验的公开图像文件。
models.features: Multi-agent analysis framework generates models and executable workflows for single-cell perturbation tasks; not one fixed predictor.

models.name: TRADE
models.note: Figure 1 以分布与效应量示意图说明统计方法，并非神经网络结构图。
models.features: Statistical model estimates the distribution and transcriptome-wide impact of differential-expression effects while accounting for estimation error.
